items.text: Understand what a foreground process is and how it blocks the terminal
Understand what a background process is and how & frees the terminal
Explain the difference between Job ID and Process ID
Explain what a Linux repository is and why it matters
Identify when to use yum, dnf, and apt based on the Linux distro
Describe what SFTP is and why it is more secure than FTP
Run a command in the background using &
Use the 'jobs' command to list background jobs
Use 'fg %N' to bring a background job to the foreground
Use 'bg %N' to resume a suspended job in the background
Use 'ps aux' and identify STAT column values (R, S, D, T, Z)
Install software using yum/dnf/apt and redirect output to a log file
Connect FileZilla to an EC2 instance via SFTP using a PEM key
Upload and download files between local machine and EC2 using FileZilla
Answer what STAT codes R, S, D, T, Z, + mean in ps aux
Explain the difference between 'systemctl start' and 'systemctl enable'
Identify which package manager to use for each Linux distribution
Explain why a background process can still print to the terminal and how to stop it
